name: themis
description: Themis — a blind-TDD gate for AI-written code. Ships the engine (pip: themis-blind-tdd) and the blind-tdd Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: blind-tdd
plugins.description: Blind TDD gate: a fresh agent writes failing tests from the spec alone (path-guard hook blocks implementation reads), the implementer makes them pass, a blind runner verifies green, and an arbiter rules on challenges.
